highlights.title_zh: MNELAB 1.7.0：XDF 导入可按流类型选择，去工频参数可配置
highlights.title_en: MNELAB 1.7.0: Per-Stream XDF Import Control and Configurable Line-Noise Removal
highlights.brief: MNELAB 发布 1.7.0（2026-10-14），两项改进直接对应日常痛点：①**XDF 导入按流分别设置**——每个流可选择作为连续通道、离散通道（触发码等不会被重采样/滤波改动）或标注导入，名义采样率 0 Hz 的数值流默认进标注，并支持更多单位；这对 Lab Streaming Layer 记录的实验尤其重要，此前触发码容易被当成信号一起处理。②**去工频可配置**——窗口长度、重叠、频率容差与跳过哪些标注区间都可设置，而不是固定一套默认参数。此外同批 12 次提交修了取消打开文件时的报错、给对话框加了多选复选框，并打磨了 macOS 外观。用 LSL/XDF 做实验流程的团队建议升级。

highlights.title_zh: MOABB 改从 AWS Open Data 镜像抓取 PhysioNet 数据，并修 Zhou2020 通道布局
highlights.title_en: MOABB Fetches PhysioNet Data from the AWS Open Data Mirror and Fixes Zhou2020 Layout
highlights.brief: MOABB 在 10 月 14 日推进 23 次提交，最实用的是 #1257：PhysioNet 官方站点提供 eegmmidb 的带宽只有 10–40 kB/s，且常在传输中途超时，pooch 重试又是从零开始——于是改为**优先从 AWS Open Data 镜像**（physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com）取数，并验证字节一致（S001R04.edf 的 md5 与 S3 ETag 相同），失败才告警并回退官方源。国内网络下这一改动对下载体验影响很大。同日 #1269 修正 Zhou2020 S-subject 的通道名与布局，#1272 改为跟踪其 IEEE DataPort DOI 以修复 CI。凡是用 MOABB 拉取 PhysioNet 类数据集的团队，升级后可显著减少「下到一半失败重来」的时间。

highlights.title_zh: MontageFlow：把生成的速度场投影到零空间，保证生成 EEG 物理有效
highlights.title_en: MontageFlow Projects Generated Velocity Fields onto a Null Space for Physically Valid EEG
highlights.brief: 新建仓库 MontageFlow（2026-10-14，对应 arXiv:2610.14507）给出一个「物理有效」的 EEG 生成模型实现：编码器把 EEG 窗口压成全局隐变量，解码器依据当前流状态、流时间、类别标签与扰动隐变量预测速度场；训练完成后用类别条件的 rectified-flow 先验替换编码器做生成。核心设计是把预测速度**投影到 ker A**（A 为与蒙太奇相关的线性算子零空间），推理时对高斯源做同样投影——生成结果在数学上被约束为满足蒙太奇/物理一致性，而非仅靠后处理。仓库结构完整（configs/、montageflow/、scripts/、tests/），权重发布在 Hugging Face，数据取 Temple University Hospital EEG 语料。

items.title_zh: MNELAB 1.7.0：XDF 导入可按流类型选择，去工频参数可配置
items.title_en: MNELAB 1.7.0: Per-Stream XDF Import Control and Configurable Line-Noise Removal
bullets_zh: XDF 导入更可控：可为每个流选择导入为连续通道、离散通道（如触发码，不被重采样与滤波改动）或标注；名义采样率为 0 Hz 的数值流默认按标注导入，并支持更多单位。
去工频对话框开放参数：窗口长度、重叠、频率容差与需跳过的标注区间均可设置。
同批 12 次提交还包含对话框多选复选框（#718）、取消打开文件时的报错修复（#717）与 macOS 外观打磨（#716）。
bullets_en: XDF import is now per-stream: choose continuous channels, discrete channels (e.g. trigger codes that resampling and filtering must not alter) or annotations; numeric streams with a nominal 0 Hz rate default to annotations, and more units are supported.
The Remove Line Noise dialog exposes window length, overlap, frequency tolerance and which annotations to skip.
The same batch of 12 commits adds multi-select checkboxes in dialogs (#718), fixes an error when cancelling a file open (#717) and polishes the macOS appearance (#716).
items.brief: MNELAB 发布 1.7.0（2026-10-14），两项改进直接对应日常痛点：①**XDF 导入按流分别设置**——每个流可选择作为连续通道、离散通道（触发码等不会被重采样/滤波改动）或标注导入，名义采样率 0 Hz 的数值流默认进标注，并支持更多单位；这对 Lab Streaming Layer 记录的实验尤其重要，此前触发码容易被当成信号一起处理。②**去工频可配置**——窗口长度、重叠、频率容差与跳过哪些标注区间都可设置，而不是固定一套默认参数。此外同批 12 次提交修了取消打开文件时的报错、给对话框加了多选复选框，并打磨了 macOS 外观。用 LSL/XDF 做实验流程的团队建议升级。
items.brief_en: MNELAB 1.7.0 (Oct 14) adds per-stream XDF import (each stream can be continuous, discrete — e.g. trigger codes kept free of resampling and filtering — or annotations, with 0 Hz numeric streams defaulting to annotations) and a configurable Remove Line Noise dialog (window, overlap, tolerance, annotations to skip), plus dialog multi-select and a cancel-open fix.
items.raw_excerpt: Release v1.7.0 (2026-10-14T11:49:43Z): "More control over XDF import: Choose for each XDF stream whether it is imported as continuous channels, discrete channels (e.g., trigger codes, which are not filtered or altered by resampling), or annotations. Numeric streams with a nominal sampling rate of 0 Hz are now imported as annotations by default" and "Configurable line noise removal: … window length, overlap, frequency tolerance, and annotations to ski[p]".
items.why_valuable: XDF 触发码不再被当信号处理，去工频参数可配，LSL 实验流程直接受益。

items.title_zh: MOABB 改从 AWS Open Data 镜像抓取 PhysioNet 数据，并修 Zhou2020 通道布局
items.title_en: MOABB Fetches PhysioNet Data from the AWS Open Data Mirror and Fixes Zhou2020 Layout
bullets_zh: #1257：physionet.org 提供 eegmmidb 的速率仅 10–40 kB/s 且会中途超时（pooch 会从零重下），改为优先从 https://physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com 取（字节一致：S001R04.edf 的 md5 == S3 ETag），失败时告警并回退上游。
#1269 修 Zhou2020 S-subject 的通道名与布局（对应 #1120）；#1272 改为跟踪 Zhou2020 的 IEEE DataPort DOI，修复 develop CI。
当日共 23 次提交，含已合并 w42 批次的评审跟进（#1271），属 MOABB 数据获取层的一次集中加固。
bullets_en: #1257: physionet.org serves eegmmidb at only 10-40 kB/s and times out mid-file (pooch then restarts from zero), so downloads now try https://physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com first (byte-identical: S001R04.edf md5 == S3 ETag) and warn plus fall back upstream.
#1269 fixes Zhou2020 S-subject channel names and layout (issue #1120), while #1272 tracks Zhou2020's IEEE DataPort DOI and repairs develop CI.
23 commits in total that day, including review follow-ups for the merged w42 batch (#1271) — a concentrated hardening of MOABB's data-fetch layer.

items.brief_en: MOABB made 23 commits on Oct 14, the most practical being #1257: since physionet.org serves eegmmidb at 10-40 kB/s and times out mid-file (pooch restarts from zero), downloads now prefer the AWS Open Data mirror physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com with byte-identical verification (S001R04.edf md5 == S3 ETag) and fall back upstream. #1269 fixes Zhou2020 channel layout.

Try https://physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com (byte-identical: S001R04.edf md5 == S3 ETag) for physionet.org/files/ URLs in data_dl and download_if_missing, warn and fall back to upstream."

items.title_zh: MontageFlow：把生成的速度场投影到零空间，保证生成 EEG 物理有效
items.title_en: MontageFlow Projects Generated Velocity Fields onto a Null Space for Physically Valid EEG
bullets_zh: 方法：编码器把 EEG 窗口映射为全局隐变量，解码器输入当前流状态、流时间、类别标签与扰动隐变量来预测速度场；训练后用以类别为条件的 rectified-flow 先验替换编码器生成。
关键约束：预测速度被投影到 ker A（A 即与蒙太奇相关的线性算子零空间），推理阶段的高斯源同样投影，从而保证生成信号满足物理/蒙太奇一致性。
仓库为 PyTorch 实现（configs/、montageflow/、scripts/、tests/），权重发布在 Hugging Face；数据使用 Temple University Hospital EEG 语料（TUAB v3.0.1 等）。
bullets_en: Method: an encoder maps an EEG window to a global latent; the decoder takes the current flow state, flow time, class label and a perturbed latent to predict a velocity field; after training, a class-conditional rectified-flow prior replaces the encoder for generation.

The key constraint projects the predicted velocity onto ker A (A being the montage-related linear operator's null space), and the Gaussian source is projected at inference too, guaranteeing physically valid EEG.
A PyTorch implementation (configs/, montageflow/, scripts/, tests/) with checkpoints on Hugging Face, using Temple University Hospital EEG corpora such as TUAB v3.0.1.
items.brief: 新建仓库 MontageFlow（2026-10-14，对应 arXiv:2610.14507）给出一个「物理有效」的 EEG 生成模型实现：编码器把 EEG 窗口压成全局隐变量，解码器依据当前流状态、流时间、类别标签与扰动隐变量预测速度场；训练完成后用类别条件的 rectified-flow 先验替换编码器做生成。核心设计是把预测速度**投影到 ker A**（A 为与蒙太奇相关的线性算子零空间），推理时对高斯源做同样投影——生成结果在数学上被约束为满足蒙太奇/物理一致性，而非仅靠后处理。仓库结构完整（configs/、montageflow/、scripts/、tests/），权重发布在 Hugging Face，数据取 Temple University Hospital EEG 语料。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-10-14 (arXiv:2610.14507), MontageFlow implements physically valid EEG generation: an encoder maps a window to a global latent and a decoder predicts a velocity field from flow state, flow time, class label and perturbed latent; a class-conditional rectified-flow prior then replaces the encoder. Velocities are projected onto ker A of the montage operator, hard-constraining outputs.
items.raw_excerpt: "MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation" (arXiv 2610.14507; checkpoints on Hugging Face). README: "…the decoder receives the current flow state X_t, flow time t, class label y, and perturbed latent h̃, and predicts a velocity field. After encoder-decoder training, a class-conditional rectified-flow prior p_ψ(h | y) … The predicted velocity is projected onto ker A. At inference, the Gaussian source is also projected to guarantee valid EEG."
items.why_valuable: 把物理约束写进生成过程（零空间投影），比后处理式有效性更可信。

items.title_zh: EEGPrep 依差分模糊测试结果收敛：对齐 resample 的 NaN 处理并跳过低频谱滤波
items.title_en: EEGPrep Closes Differential-Fuzz Findings: NaN Parity in Resample, Low-Rate Spectral Filter Skipped
bullets_zh: #469 对齐 resample 对 NaN 的支持并清理误报的 fuzz 记录——模糊测试框架的输出开始被逐条处置，而不是堆积告警。
#470 记录短数据下 ASR 的校准行为，并在采样率过低时跳过谱滤波（避免数学上无意义的操作）。
这两项都是「与 EEGLAB 对照」发现的差异，说明前一日加入的每日差分模糊测试已在产出可执行的修复项。
bullets_en: #469 matches resample's NaN support and drops false-positive fuzz filings, so triage replaces an ever-growing warning pile.
#470 documents ASR calibration behaviour on short recordings and skips spectral filtering when the sampling rate is too low to make sense.
Both are divergences surfaced by the comparison against EEGLAB, showing the nightly differential fuzzing added the day before is already producing actionable fixes.
items.brief: EEGPrep 在 10 月 14 日合并两项由「与 EEGLAB 差分模糊测试」产出的修复：#469 让 resample 的 NaN 处理与 MATLAB 实现对齐，并剔除误报的 fuzz 记录（避免告警噪声淹没真问题）；#470 记录短记录下 ASR 的校准行为，并在采样率过低时**跳过谱滤波**——后者是典型的「数学上无意义但在脚本里照做」的操作。这标志着前一天加入的每日差分模糊测试已形成闭环：发现问题 → 人工确认容差 → 落地修复。对准备把预处理从 MATLAB 迁到 Python 的实验室，这类逐条对齐比「功能列表看起来一样」更有说服力；建议关注其未关闭的 divergence 列表，作为迁移风险评估依据。
items.brief_en: EEGPrep merged two fixes produced by its differential fuzzing against EEGLAB on Oct 14: #469 aligns resample's NaN support with the MATLAB implementation and drops false-positive fuzz filings, while #470 documents ASR calibration on short recordings and skips spectral filtering when the sampling rate is too low. The nightly fuzz harness is now a closed loop from detection to fix.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-10-14: "Match resample NaN support and drop false fuzz filings (#469)" 16:06Z and "Document short ASR calibration and skip a low-rate spectral filter. (#470)" 16:35Z — both following the nightly differential fuzzing against EEGLAB added on 2026-10-12.
items.why_valuable: 差分模糊测试形成闭环并落地修复，为 MATLAB→Python 迁移提供可核证据。

items.title_zh: braindecode 复用 EMA 码本距离存储提速，并恢复 DANCE 检查点评测说明
items.title_en: braindecode Reuses EMA Codebook Distance Storage and Restores DANCE Checkpoint Evaluation Docs
bullets_zh: #1404 在码本查找时复用 EMA 的距离存储，减少重复计算（向量量化类模型训练/推理的常见热点）。
#1406 恢复 DANCE 检查点的评测说明并澄清验证分数口径，避免复现者误读指标。
#1405 在改动前校验拼接数据集的描述长度；另有 STEEGFormer 等子类 on_non_divisible 填充的遗留修复，当日共 8 次提交。
bullets_en: #1404 reuses the EMA codebook's distance storage during lookup, cutting duplicated computation in vector-quantisation models.
#1406 recovers the DANCE checkpoint evaluation documentation and clarifies what the validation score means, preventing misread metrics.
#1405 validates concatenated dataset description lengths before mutation, plus a legacy fix for on_non_divisible fill in subclasses such as STEEGFormer — eight commits that day.
items.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 14 日推进 8 次提交：#1404 在码本查找时复用 EMA（指数滑动平均）的距离存储，减少向量量化类模型里重复的距离计算——这类操作在训练与推理路径上都会被反复触发；#1406 恢复 DANCE 检查点的评测说明并澄清验证分数的定义，属于「防止复现者误读指标」的文档修复；#1405 在修改前校验拼接数据集的描述长度，避免不合法状态被写入。另有 STEEGFormer 等子类 on_non_divisible 填充的遗留问题修复。对使用 DANCE 或带码本结构的 EEG 模型的团队，升级后建议重跑一次检查点评测流程，确认指标口径与文档一致。
items.brief_en: braindecode made eight commits on Oct 14: #1404 reuses the EMA codebook's distance storage during lookup to cut duplicated computation in vector-quantised EEG models, #1406 restores and clarifies the DANCE checkpoint evaluation documentation, and #1405 validates concatenated dataset descriptions before mutation, plus a legacy on_non_divisible fill fix.
items.raw_excerpt: "PERF reuse EMA codebook distance storage during lookup (#1404)" 19:37Z; "DOC recover DANCE checkpoint evaluation and clarify validation score (#1406)" 18:54Z; "FIX validate concatenated dataset description lengths before mutation (#1405)" 18:52Z — 8 commits on 2026-10-14.
items.why_valuable: 码本距离复用减少重复计算，且澄清了 DANCE 指标口径避免误读。

items.title_zh: EEG-ExPy 合并两份已分叉的 plot_conditions（破坏性重构）
items.title_en: EEG-ExPy Merges Two Diverged Copies of plot_conditions (Breaking Refactor)
bullets_zh: #342 合并 eegnb 中两份已经分叉的 plot_conditions：analysis_utils.py 本是 utils.py 的副本，两边此后被分别修补，导致接受的参数不一致。
标记为破坏性变更（`!`），涉及 13 个文件；N170 等示例此前已指向 eegnb.analysis.utils，本次把实现真正收敛到一处。
对基于 EEG-ExPy / eegnb 教学材料写脚本的人，升级需检查调用签名，但长期收益是「同一函数不再有两个行为」。
bullets_en: #342 merges two diverged copies of plot_conditions in eegnb: analysis_utils.py started as a copy of utils.py, then each copy was patched separately, leaving them accepting different arguments.
It is flagged breaking (`!`) and touches 13 files; examples such as N170 already pointed at eegnb.analysis.utils, and this makes the implementation single-sourced.
Anyone scripting on EEG-ExPy/eegnb teaching material should check call signatures, with the long-term gain that one function no longer behaves two ways.
items.brief: EEG-ExPy 合并 #342（破坏性重构）：把 eegnb 中两份已经分叉的 plot_conditions 真正合并——`analysis_utils.py` 原本只是 `utils.py` 的副本，此后两边被分别修补（#329/#330），导致同一个函数在两处接受的参数不同，用户按文档调用可能得到不一致的图与报错。本次涉及 13 个文件，把实现收敛到 `eegnb.analysis.utils` 一处。这类「复制粘贴后各自演化」是教学类项目最常见的技术债，值得记录的原因有两点：一是它解释了此前若干诡异的参数错误；二是它提醒使用 EEG-ExPy/eegnb 材料的人，升级后要复查自己脚本里的调用签名。
items.brief_en: EEG-ExPy merged the breaking refactor #342, genuinely merging two diverged copies of plot_conditions: analysis_utils.py began as a copy of utils.py and both were patched separately (#329/#330), so one function accepted different arguments in two places. The change touches 13 files and single-sources the implementation, explaining earlier odd parameter errors.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #342: "refactor(analysis)!: keep one plot_conditions in eegnb.analysis.utils — `eegnb/analysis/analysis_utils.py` was a copy of `utils.py` added in #263, and its `plot_conditions` drifted away from the one in `utils.py`. #330 and #329 then fixed each copy separately, so the two still differ in what they accept." Merged 2026-10-14T12:32:15Z, 13 files.
items.why_valuable: 消除两份分叉实现，解释了既有参数不一致问题并提示升级需改签名。
